description: Update the authenticated bot's global username, avatar image, or banner image. Changes apply globally across every server the bot is in. Changing the username can randomize the discriminator. To change the bot's nickname or avatar in one guild only, use discord_update_my_guild_member (members toolset). Returns the updated bot user object. No special bot permissions. Destructive: the user is asked to approve the exact change before it runs.

anyOf.description: Image payload formatted as an RFC 2397 base64 data URI (data:image/{png|jpeg|gif|webp};base64,...)

avatar.description: New avatar image as a base64 data URI (png, jpeg, gif, webp), or null to clear avatar

anyOf.description: Image payload formatted as an RFC 2397 base64 data URI (data:image/{png|jpeg|gif|webp};base64,...)

banner.description: New banner image as a base64 data URI (png, jpeg, gif, webp), or null to clear banner

username.description: New global username for the bot account (2 to 32 characters); cannot contain @, #, :, three backticks (```) or 'discord', and cannot be 'everyone' or 'here'

name: discord_update_my_user

id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string
